svg.title: Lord of Prudence: Eight of Pentacles · Sun in Virgo · Hod (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Sun above the painting and Virgo below, as Book T places them: "Above and below them are the symbols Sun and Virgo for the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1793138480287-yjlaqt8jmjp.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
